thread:
jasmine: quick ping 1 i'm iterating on an automatic fallback UX that includes a 'preview' toggle + explicit handback cadence. want ops + eng + legal reads before i wireframe.
kevin: sounds useful. two questions: 1) preview should run on sampled traffic or synthetic? 2) how do we indicate confidence/why it triggered?
leah: preview = sampled replay is my vote. show three anonymized examples and a small metric delta (latency, top-1 quality). avoid synthetic for fidelity.
tom: Agree on sampling. add a history sparkline showing recent trigger density so operators can spot oscillation.
jasmine: proposing UI affordances: badge on route -> "fallback active (preview)"; action menu: [Take Live] [Pause Auto-Fallback] [Open Audit].
greg: policy model thought: represent hysteresis explicitly, e.g. min_consecutive_trips and cool_down_ms. backend will need to expose those fields.
kevin: sample policy sketch:
```json
{
  "id": "pf-2024-01",
  "mode": "auto-fallback",
  "trigger": {"type": "error_rate","threshold_pct": 5},
  "hysteresis": {"min_consecutive": 3, "cool_down_ms": 120000},
  "scope": {"routes": ["/qa","/chat"], "sample_policy": "first_n_non_pii:3"},
  "handback": {"strategy": "staggered","steps": ["10%","50%","100%"], "step_interval_s": 60}
}
```
kevin: also include "trigger_index" so audit can replay exact event window.
ops-bot: Alert: preview invoked on /qa at 2024-06-15T10:03:20Z (trigger_idx=tz_33b).
leah: UI needs to show redaction flag on examples. when redacted=true show shield icon + tooltip "redacted for privacy".
ui-bot: UX suggestion: when "preview" is on, visually dim the route responses and overlay quality deltas inline so product folks can eyeball change. also add a keyboard shortcut to toggle preview.
jasmine: legal: are we OK with sampling-first-3-by-default?
legal-bot: default sampling is OK if PII is redacted. require tenant opt-out for customers with strict data residency. log immutably that samples were redacted.
greg: edge: oscillation. if signals bounce, we must avoid flip-flop. suggest add "max_auto_cycles_per_hour" and a backoff multiplier on step_interval_s.
kevin: implementation note: telemetry must emit events: fallback_applied, fallback_step, fallback_released, each with policy_snapshot and trigger_idx. also emit availability metrics so console can compute SLO impact.
leah: audit panel fields: time, trigger_idx, trigger_type, policy_id, scope_summary, samples_link, operator_action_history. make operator actions append immutable note.
tom: logging format: single-line JSON event with keys: ts, route, policy_id, trigger_idx, action, quick_stats. full snapshot stored in blob store with pointer.
jasmine: question: do we allow manual immediate handback? i'm worried about noisy manual flips.
greg: allow, but role-gate it. show a confirmation modal listing potential ripple (billing, latency). manual handback must be recorded as operator_action.
kevin: also add a preview-simulate endpoint that returns sample output under fallback so UI doesn't need to call production live traffic. good for product review.
leah: follow-ups: 1) greg & kevin define schema for policy + telemetry; 2) jasmine & ui-bot do a quick mock of preview overlay; 3) legal-bot to confirm redaction checklist. reconvene tomorrow 9:30am?
jasmine: thanks all 44D reconvene 9:30 works for me.
